verdict.rationale: llama.cpp explicitly documents downloading pre-built binaries from GitHub releases, as well as Docker images and a Winget package, as alternatives to building from source [llama-cpp-gh-12][llama-cpp-gh-11][llama-cpp-gh-20][llama-cpp-gh-19]. Community evidence confirms usage of official release binaries, though one user needed a macOS quarantine workaround to run them [llama-cpp-comm-17]. Missing for 10: broader package manager coverage (e.g. apt/brew) evidence and more independent corroboration of prebuilt binary reliability across platforms.
